name: Miku's Cyber Adventure
source:
While hanging out together on your local hard drive, disaster strikes: Ren steals Miku’s favorite mint chocolate chip ice cream!

Take Miku's hand as you jump through network gateways, dodge flying system glitches, bypass firewall partitions, and hunt down the ice cream thief through vocal effect directories. Along the way, you'll sneak into Luka's cookie-baking studio, relax in an elegant digital courtyard garden, and even get treated to an exclusive, private neon concert on the main stage—just for you!

[From [url=https://ctucftydfiytysiilyiyhi.itch.io/hatsune-miku-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你与初音未来在本地硬盘里悠闲玩耍时，一场大祸从天而降：镜音连偷走了未来最爱的薄荷巧克力碎冰淇淋！

牵起初音未来的手，一同跃过网络网关、躲开漫天飞舞的系统故障碎片、绕过防火墙分区，穿过层层声效文件夹追捕冰淇淋大盗吧！旅途之中，你还将悄悄潜入巡音流歌的曲奇烘焙工坊、在雅致的数字庭院花园中小憩放松，甚至还能在主舞台上独享一场专属于你一人的私密霓虹演唱会！
